# kernel_telemetry_destination (Resource)

Kernel OTLP telemetry destination. Browser sessions reference a destination by ID or name in `telemetry.export.otlp.destination` to export their telemetry to it. Destinations are organization-scoped and require an organization-scoped API key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Base OTLP/HTTP collector endpoint, without a signal path such as `/v1/logs`. Must be a public http or https URL with no query string or fragment, for example `https://api.honeycomb.io`.
- `name` (String) Destination name. Must be unique within the organization, match `^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,255}$`, and not look like an ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Destination description.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent with each export request, typically an ingestion key. Header names are matched case-insensitively. Kernel never returns header values, so Terraform detects added or removed header names but not values changed outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique telemetry destination identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import kernel_telemetry_destination.example <telemetry-destination-id>
```
